# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can move one object, up to 1 pound in mass, up to 1' per second (with
no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up,
the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell with an equal
weight limit cast upon it.
@@ 2
Exerts 5 pounds of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by
Staying alone and pressure can only be in one direction.
@@ 3
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.
@@ 4
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 25 pounds.
@@ 5
As Staying II, except 2 objects may be affected with 5 pounds total pressure
or Staying II can be used to 200'.
@@ 6
As Telekinesis I, except 2 objects of 5 pounds total mass may be moved or
Telekinesis I can be used at 200'.
@@ 7
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.
@@ 8
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 50 pounds.
@@ 9
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.
@@ 10
Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of him) of 1 pound or
less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on either the RMFRP Missile
Weapon Attack Table A-10.9.4 (p. 223) or the Arms Law Sling Attack Table 2.24
(p. 53). Treat as a sling attack with a short range of 11-100 ', a medium
range of 101-200', and a long range of 201'-300'. The caster’s OB is his
directed spell skill with this spell.
@@ 11
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 100 pounds.
@@ 12
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.
@@ 13
As Hurling I, except mass limit is 5 pounds and it delivers double normal
concussion hits.
@@ 14
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 200 pounds.
@@ 15
As Greater Staying II, except 3 objects may be affected with 25 pounds total
pressure or Staying I can be used to 300'.
@@ 16
As Telekinesis I, except 3 objects of 25 pounds total mass may be moved or
Telekinesis I can be used to 300'.
@@ 17
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 200 pounds.
@@ 18
As Hurling II, except limit is 25 pounds and delivers triple normal concussion
hits.
@@ 19
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 20 pounds per level.
@@ 20
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 20 pounds per level.
@@ 25
As Hurling I, except the object to be hurled may start up to 300' away or the
caster may hurl 3 objects that start up to 100' away (at the same target).
@@ 30
As Hurling II, except limit is 50 pounds and it delivers four times normal
concussion hits and the OB has an additional +50 bonus.
@@ 50
Each round, the caster may use any lower level spell on this list with a range
of 300'.
